descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
该接口和**BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId**接口结合使用，在一个产品下批量注册多个设备，并且为每个设备单独命名。
批量注册设备流程：

1. 调用本接口，传入要批量注册的设备的名称，物联网平台返回申请批次ID（**ApplyId**）。返回成功结果，表示批量校验设备名称的申请已经提交成功。实际的校验是异步执行的，会有一个过程。
2. 调用[QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus](~~69483~~)查看名称设置结果。
3.  调用[BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~)批量注册设备。
4. （可选）调用[QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus](~~69483~~)查看设备注册结果。
5. 调用[QueryPageByApplyId](~~69518~~)查看批量注册的设备信息。

## 使用限制
单次调用，最多能定义1,0000 个设备名称。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享该阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

Use this API together with the **BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId** API to register multiple devices under one product and assign a unique name to each device.

The batch device registration flow is as follows:

1. Call this API and pass the names of the devices you want to register in batch. The IoT Platform returns an application batch ID (**ApplyId**). A successful response indicates that the request to validate the device names in batch has been successfully submitted. The actual validation is executed asynchronously and takes some time.
2. Call [QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus](~~69483~~) to view the result of the name validation.
3. Call [BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~) to register the devices in batch.
4. (Optional) Call [QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus](~~69483~~) to check the device registration result.
5. Call [QueryPageByApplyId](~~69518~~) to view the information of the registered devices.

## Limits

You can define up to 10,000 device names in a single call.

## QPS Limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can make a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-check-device-names --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name example-string --device-name-list DeviceNickname=example-string DeviceName=example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
